'''Darth Aruk''' was a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Dark Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a member of the Dark Council, Aruk was in charge of the [[Sphere of Sith Philosophy]], and as such was responsible for upholding the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Sith Code]] and spreading anti-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] teachings throughout the Empire. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] also attempted to weed out [[Order of Revan|Revanite]] cultists who diluted the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] with heresy concerning [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] balanced approach to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

By [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.10.3}}</ref> Aruk, or whoever succeeded Aruk on the Dark Council, was believed to be [[Death/Legends|dead]], as [[Darth Vowrawn]] was thought to be the only remaining member of the Dark Council alive aside from [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]], who reorganized the Dark Council into five seats and folded the Sphere of Sith Philosophy into the [[Sphere of Sith Doctrine]].<ref name="Siege">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181130|text=Jedi Under Siege: State of the Galaxy}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Aruk was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a reference guide for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' published by [[Dorling Kindersley]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> on [[October 15]], [[2012]].<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/358252/star-wars-the-old-republic-encyclopedia-by-ian-ryan|text=Star Wars: The Old Republic: Encyclopedia}}</ref> Aruk is the only member of the Council mentioned in the Encyclopedia that does not appear in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' aside from [[Darth Rictus]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> who made his debut a month after the Encyclopedia was published in the companion novel ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'',<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and released on [[November 13]], 2012.<ref name="amazon">{{InsiderCite|137|Blaster}}</ref>
